font_source: tools/host_font.py fixed noto-cjk f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c; OFL retained with font
epub_access: owned next() for first/sequential with explicit EOF; recreate borrowed get() pager for random and include recreation time
oversize_page_policy: Only after get() returns EXR_LIMIT, drop its failed cache and replay a fresh owned next() pager to target; accept fallback only if observed exr_layout_memory_size exceeds the unchanged 8MiB cache budget. Include rejected get, failed cache release, construction and replay time; free temporary page. The next random operation recreates its cache. Require same route RGBA and selected UTF-8 text as sequential. No claim that get() accepts oversized pages.
cpu_policy: pin each native process to first allowed logical CPU
disk_cache: prime input and font before every fresh native process; OS cache not flushed
percentile_method: nearest rank over retained operation samples; startup percentiles across five fresh processes
budget_policy: diagnostic run first; commit baseline-derived numeric budgets before a separate enforcing run; never widen to make a failing candidate pass
